business_problem: Delivery Hero needed a data platform that could ingest petabytes of Q-commerce data at scale, keep mission-critical cost calculations resilient, and stop senior engineers from spending time firefighting Spark infrastructure.
solution_summary: Delivery Hero uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Delivery Hero needed a data platform that could ingest petabytes of Q-commerce data at scale, keep mission-critical cost calculations resilient, and stop senior engineers from spending time firefighting Spark infrastructure. Managed Service for Apache Spark runs high-volume raw data import pipelines on provisioned clusters and also executes critical workloads in serverless mode when resilience matters most, serving as the compute layer. BigQuery receives the clean, governed data that downstream analytics, supply-chain planning, personalization, and machine learning teams depend on, serving as the storage layer. Petabyte-scale raw data is ingested through Apache Spark workloads on Google Cloud, critical jobs such as weighted average cost calculations move to serverless Spark for resilience, and the resulting clean datasets are delivered into BigQuery for analytics, forecasting, and downstream ML use.

evidence_quotes: Lowered TCO and reduced hours spent on cluster management

The company is a pioneer in Quick Commerce (Q-commerce)—the next generation of ecommerce aiming to bring groceries and household goods to customers in under one hour and often in 20 to 30 minutes. For the data platform team supporting this vertical, this high-speed business model demands a data architecture that is equally agile and robust.
For their large-scale, high-volume raw data import pipelines, the team runs Spark on provisioned Managed Service for Apache Spark clusters.
By migrating the Weighted Average Cost (WAC) calculation to serverless Managed Spark, the team no longer has to think about the underlying infrastructure.
The stability of their data platform provides the fresh, accurate data needed to support this evolution.
